name: TraceForge
description: Signal paths, PCB tools and deterministic manufacturing packages for KiCad 10
description_full: TraceForge combines signal path timing, trace cleanup, rounded track corners, component rotation, via tools including live via-in-pad and stitching-cleanup scanners, RF via fencing, BGA fanout and live net visualization in one PCB Editor panel. The Manufacturing tab reviews saved projects and builds PCBWay or PCBPower deliverable packages. PCB editing reads the live board through KiCad 10's pcbnew bindings. This PCM package is for Windows; the separate macOS installer is a testing preview. See the project homepage for setup and known limits.
